properties.name: es.rate-limit.provider
properties.description: Declaring what provider of rate limiting should be used. Allowed options are: local, waf.

properties.name: es.scheduler.enabled
properties.description: Whether scheduler should be enabled. Preferred to be disabled when running with multiple instances to avoid overriding.

properties.name: es.websocket.enabled
properties.description: Whether websocket should be enabled. Important to disable it when broker is not configured.
